item: A Stop is not a failure in thirteen more recorders (the R614 epoch, R617 PR B, R618)
refs: R617 R618 R614 R320 PR pending
summary: Each recorder now takes the R614 engagement epoch before its own switch check and reads kill_switch_engaged_since after the request, so a Stop (still engaged, or pressed and cleared inside the request) records nothing. Before/after: walk and warm read a connect the socket guard refused as the edition's WAIT_CONNECTION, now PAUSED_NETWORK_OFF (HTTP answers stay the host's); wiki track committed a revision whose text, diff or ORES fetch a Stop cut and moved last_revid past it, now it rolls back and raises NetworkBlocked (skipped_offline, asked again); the versioned pass cooled down and listed a cut fetch as an error, now it stops fetching with neither; ORES called a cut or by-name refusal a transport error, now refused_offline; the wiki stream counted a cut connection with backoff, now it does not; the markets pass and the import-all route read kill_switch_active after the error, now the feed's epoch; run_rule stamped fetch_failed on every rule after a Stop (Home: price feed needs attention, R320), now skipped_offline with no stamp and run_rules stops (the run-now route answers skipped_offline, still naming the switch; the consent-coverage probe pins it); a field-test step a Stop cut was done for good, now it runs again; the items job and OSM replication read the epoch too. R618: in OpenTimestamps mode a Stop made custody write a permanent local-only proof, now it raises TimestampUnavailable naming the switch and the ingest auto-log queues the entry as owed for a later anchor (not-installed fallback unchanged); the ring loader had no switch check and recorded a cut candidate as its error, now a Stop ends the load with no error. Genuine failures with no Stop are recorded as before (a control test per site). Tests: tests/test_kill_switch_epoch_recorders_r617b.py (57); 35 mutants (epoch reads removed or reduced to active-now, loop captures moved after the head check, head checks, guards, break) all killed. Cost: a genuine failure that shares its window with a Stop is not recorded and is asked again. Release-notes line: Pressing Stop no longer leaves false failures behind in the Wikipedia, markets, field-test, items, map-replication, ring and custody records; whatever the Stop interrupted is simply asked again later.
